ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious Inline JavaScript Execution via NodeJS Binary
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potentially suspicious inline JavaScript execution using Node.js with specific keywords in the command line.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\node\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "node\.exe" OR process_product = "Node\.js") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*http.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*execSync.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*spawn.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*fs.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*path.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*zlib.*")))
